column1: # Layer map (LR-142): each layer of the factory, what it catches and what it misses. escape-map.py reads it; design/escapes.tsv names one layer per escape.
# Tab-separated: layer, catches, misses. Code review guide: "Each layer catches some problems and misses others".

column2: the builder's own run of the row's tests and guards before a push
column3: what the builder did not think to test; checks run on a stale copy

column2: logic and scope errors in the diff, read in a fresh context (P-303)
column3: failures that only show when the code runs against main or other suites

column2: breakage through the UI and the API on a built screen
column3: pipeline and tooling changes (no screen to break)

column2: the PR's own checks and affected suites on its head
column3: interactions with what lands on main after its run; suites a path filter skipped

column2: risky-path problems Claude Code Review finds on the PR
column3: anything when it is skipped (balance, mode); it never blocks by itself

column2: a merge without the required approval
column3: the content of an approved change

column2: conflicts and failures of the PR batched with main (merge queue)
column3: checks the batch does not run (nightly, scheduled, slow suites)

column2: a capability that does not work end to end, tested like a person on main
column3: faults in tooling, pipeline and records; anything outside the capability walked
